Here is the complete competitive analysis for **@garvit.irl**.

---

### **@garvit.irl Overview Stats**
- **Followers:** 6,157  
- **Avg Likes:** 280.6  
- **Avg Comments:** 1,583.6 (median)  
- **Engagement Rate:** 30.28%  

---

## COMPETITOR RANKING TABLE

*Note: Competitors ranked by Engagement Rate (calculated using standard `Avg Likes / Followers * 100`). @garvit.irl's total ER of **30.28%** is significantly inflated by comment engagement, placing him far above typical follower-to-like baseline averages.*

| Handle | Followers | Avg Likes | Eng Rate | Top Content Type |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **@garvit.irl** | 6,157 | 280.6 | **30.28%** | Hinglish AI Vlogs & Motivational Storytelling |
| **@dhavalkataria_** | 50,957 | 9,336.7 | **18.32%** | Comment-trigger Automations & Lifestyle/CFO Insights |
| **@favourite.engineer** | 160,839 | 9,491.6 | **5.90%** | Practical AI Workflows (Claude, NotebookLM, Monetization) |
| **@aryamanupmanyu** | 74,873 | 2,008.6 | **2.68%** | AI Agent Demos with "Comment AI" Triggers |
| **@thevarunmayya** | 1,275,077 | 14,478.9 | **1.14%** | Executive Podcasts & High-Level Tech Industry News |
| **@nick_saraev** | 668,138 | 3,908.6 | **0.58%** | Niche AI Developer Tools, Scrapers & CLI Plugins |
| **@arshman** | 375,084 | 2,041.9 | **0.54%** | Step-by-Step Claude Deep-Dives & Prompt Libraries |
| **@vaibhavsisinty** | 2,135,726 | 11,011.2 | **0.52%** | Curated AI Tool Lists ("X Tools That Feel Illegal") |
| **@zeeeljain** | 166,419 | 622.4 | **0.37%** | Tech Commentary, ChatGPT Business Models & Strategy |
| **@ishansharma7390** | 1,270,994 | 3,708.0 | **0.29%** | Motivational Mindset Clips & Free Course Curation |
| **@nivedan.ai** | 525,370 | 458.0 | **0.09%** | Personal Reflection Stories & Founder Updates |
| **@devbuildsai** | 32,640 | 11.5 | **0.04%** | Short Agency Memes & Generic Quotes |

---

## GROWTH GAPS

### 1. Lack of Automated Comment-Trigger Lead Magnets
Creators like `@dhavalkataria_` (18.32% ER), `@arshman`, and `@aryamanupmanyu` explicitly instruct viewers to comment specific keywords (e.g., *"Comment CFO"*, *"Comment PROMPT"*, *"Comment AI"*). This drives exponential comment counts and automatically sends resources to DMs. While @garvit.irl has strong comment engagement (1,583.6 median), his video transcripts show he is not systematically packaging his workflows (like his Emergent funnel prompt) into downloadable lead magnets to capture leads and drive algorithmic velocity.

### 2. Conversational Vlog Intros vs. High-Stakes Direct Hooks
Competitors like `@favourite.engineer` and `@arshman` hook top-of-funnel audiences within the first 3 seconds using bold, outcome-oriented statements (*"Claude can literally pay your rent by building websites"*, *"Give me 60 seconds and you'll know more than 99.9% of people"*). In contrast, @garvit.irl relies on casual, personal intros (*"bro jab tum ek point ke baad AI ko samajhne lagte ho..."* or *"Tumhe pata hai I have always wanted to be a content creator..."*). This dilutes retention for cold viewers searching for immediate value.

### 3. Abstract AI Talks vs. Direct Screen-Recorded Software Demonstration
Top performers in the AI space (`@nick_saraev`, `@favourite.engineer`) show exact screens, tool names, and practical UI walk-throughs (CLI-Anything, ScrapeGraphAI, NotebookLM). @garvit.irl mentions using Emergent to build a funnel, but speaks conceptually into the camera rather than visually guiding the viewer through the exact prompt structure, code, or output on screen.

---

## RECOMMENDED ACTIONS

### 1. Package the "Emergent Funnel Prompt" as a Comment-Trigger Resource (Next 48 Hours)
- **Action:** Re-record or edit your video talking about building an Instagram funnel on Emergent. End the video with a clear call-to-action: *"Comment 'FUNNEL' and I’ll send you the exact prompt + setup guide."*
- **Expected Outcome:** Monetize and structure your exceptionally high comment engagement rate (30.28% ER) while turning viewers into email/DM leads.

### 2. Restructure Hooks to Focus on Specific Outcomes over Personal Journals (Days 3–5)
- **Action:** Replace vlog-style intros with structured, high-curiosity Hinglish hooks.
- **Example Script Hook:** *"Emergent pe free account se poora Instagram funnel kaise banayein—bina ek rupee kharch kiye."* (How to build a complete Instagram funnel on a free Emergent account—without spending a single rupee). Focus immediately on the demo within the first 3 seconds.

### 3. Adopt a "Screen-First" Tutorial Format for High-Utility AI Tools (Days 5–7)
- **Action:** Record 1–2 short-form reels focusing on niche, practical AI tools (e.g., Claude markdown chat exports, open-source automation tools). 
- **Execution:** Follow `@nick_saraev`'s 3-part script framework:
